case_name: Smt.Jayashree W/O Gulappa Pujar vs Sri Gulappa S/O Basappa Pujar

parties.respondent_defendant: Sri Gulappa S/O Basappa Pujar (husband) and Rachayya S/O Channabasayya Halligerimath (co-respondent)

facts_of_case: The wife filed a petition under Section 13(1)(i)&(ia)&(ib) of Hindu Marriage Act against the husband seeking dissolution of marriage. The husband alleged that the wife had extra marital life with co-respondent and sought decree of divorce.

legal_principles.principle: The cause of action is required to be decided based on the date on which the allegation of fraud were brought to the notice of the respondent-husband.

legal_principles.principle: A petition seeking dissolution of marriage can be challenged on the ground that it is obtained by playing fraud.
legal_principles.held: The main contention of the learned counsel for the revision petitioner is that the compromise decree was passed long back on 10.07.2014 itself and hence, this petition is barred by law of limitation

outcome.final_order: The court set aside the order passed by the trial court rejecting the application filed under Order VII Rule 11 of CPC for rejection of the plaint-petition.
